finding.claim: Unauthenticated SSRF: the `feed` POST parameter is passed straight to file_get_contents(), which fetches arbitrary http(s)/ftp URLs (and other wrappers such as file:// and php://). No auth, allowlist, scheme check or host/IP filtering is applied. The response body length is echoed, so the caller gets a blind oracle. Examples: http://169.254.169.254/ (cloud metadata), internal services, localhost ports. Response size and timing allow internal port and host scanning and content-length probing.
finding.sink: file_get_contents($_POST['feed']) at import.php:12; output strlen($xml) echoed at import.php:13

trace.note: Branch entered on any POST with `feed` set. require_admin() is not called here.
User-supplied value passed directly to file_get_contents() as the URL.
Length of the fetched body is returned, giving a blind SSRF oracle.

finding.guards_checked: require_admin() (import.php:4-9) is defined but is only called in the set_webhook branch (line 18), not in the feed branch. There is no scheme or host allowlist, no private/link-local IP blocking, no DNS resolution check, and no allow_url_fopen restriction in the file. Redirects are followed by default. The session is started but never checked for this path.

verdict.reason: import.php:11-13 passes $_POST['feed'] straight to file_get_contents() and echoes strlen($xml). require_admin() (import.php:4-9) is only called in the set_webhook branch at line 18, and no scheme or host validation exists.
